title: Turnberry · Original Data
summary: Play all 18 holes of Turnberry's Ailsa course on the original PGA Tour 2005 course geometry, textures, tees and pins, decoded locally from your own disc images. Ball physics, rules and the golfer are approximate native development code.
notes: This is a native development prototype, not Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2005 or a verified port.

Original per-hole terrain, materials, tees and pins come from the local TUR course files; all 18 tees and pins validate against their floors. Run python3 Tools/prepare_pga2005.py once to prepare them.

Lies, lie records, launch power and rolling resistance follow statically recovered original surface rules. Ball flight, bounces, slipping, cup capture and drop placement are approximate native rules until the original physics are reconstructed. Original vegetation, golfer, audio and modes are not included yet.
Each hole loads its own original world with the standard condition layers (0x420) that the original CHole::Load selects, from static analysis.
Rounds save when paused, between holes and on exit, and resume only onto identical course data.
Performance on the required M1 MacBook Air at 2560 × 1600 has not been measured for this module yet.
keyboard: Left / Right or A / D: aim. Up / Down or W / S: choose club. H: aim at pin.
Space / Return or click: start swing, set power, set accuracy. Drag horizontally: aim. Scroll: zoom.
C: switch camera. Escape: cancel swing, then pause. R: restart hole while stationary or paused. F: fullscreen.
controller: A: swing / resume / advance. Left stick or D-pad left/right: aim. LB / RB or D-pad up/down: choose club.
Y: aim at pin (when paused: restart hole). X: switch camera. Right stick up/down: zoom. B: cancel / pause. Menu: pause.
